about: Tanla Platforms Ltd (formerly Tanla Solutions Ltd) is a cloud communications provider enabling businesses to communicate with their customers and intended recipients. It is headquartered in Hyderabad, India. It is a global A2P(application to person) messaging platform provider. [1] [2]
